description: Compute Pearson + Spearman correlation between two indicators for one entity. Returns r, p-value, n, and human-readable interpretation. Use for "does X move with Y?" questions. Includes causation disclaimer automatically. Runs on any verified autario indicator (World Bank, FRED, Eurostat, OECD, IMF, WHO, ECB, US Census, SEC).

full.description: Return the full raw time series (heavy, many tokens). Default false → you get only the summary/stats, which is enough to ANSWER a question. Set true only when you must plot or export every point.

name: correlate
